en: Two EMNLP 2026 papers are on arXiv with code: [StateTrack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31314) and [SurveyGraph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31317).
zh: 两篇 EMNLP 2026 论文已公开于 arXiv 并开源代码：[StateTrack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31314) 与 [SurveyGraph](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31317)。

en: [ReMCTS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34717) (EMNLP 2026) and our ACM MM 2026 paper on [object-dependent concept brittleness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09909) are on arXiv with code.
zh: [ReMCTS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.34717)（EMNLP 2026）与 ACM MM 2026 论文 [Interpreting Object-Dependent Concept Brittleness in Text-to-Image Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.09909) 已公开于 arXiv 并开源代码。

en: New preprint on how LLM agent handoffs erode workflow constraints: [When “Must” Becomes “Maybe”](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24569).
zh: 新 Preprint [When “Must” Becomes “Maybe”: Erosion of Workflow Constraints in LLM Agent Handoffs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.24569)，研究多智能体交接过程中工作流约束的流失。
一篇论文被 **ACM MM 2026** 接收。

en: Joined the College of Artificial Intelligence, Shenzhen University as an Assistant Professor.
zh: 加入深圳大学人工智能学院，任助理教授、硕士生导师。

en: One paper published in **IEEE/CAA Journal of Automatica Sinica**, with [code](https://github.com/Sherlockyyf/Semantic_Discrepancy).
zh: 一篇论文发表于 **IEEE/CAA Journal of Automatica Sinica**，[代码](https://github.com/Sherlockyyf/Semantic_Discrepancy)已开源。

en: Received my Ph.D. from the School of Computer Science and Technology, Fudan University, advised by Prof. Junping Zhang.
zh: 于复旦大学计算机科学技术学院博士毕业，导师张军平教授。
